input: Ashtakavarga ayus method 1: count bindus in each of the 12 houses of each planet's ashtakavarga and of Lagna's
outcome: Each house gives a small ayus increment that grows with bindus count; sum over 12 houses per planet, halve it, add over 7 planets and Lagna to get total ayus
strength_note: Book table OCR garbled; only 0 bindus = 2 days, 5 = 2 months, 6 = 4 months, 7 = 6 months, 8 = 8 months readable

input: In a planet's ashtakavarga house, bindus exceed rekhas / rekhas exceed bindus / equal
outcome: Ayus per house: each excess bindu = 1 year; each excess rekha = half day; equal bindus and rekhas = 7.5 days; sum over houses of all planets and Lagna, halve
strength_note: Result in nakshatra years, add or subtract multiples of 27 to agree with yoga/dasa longevity

input: Shodhyapinda of each of 7 planets known and number of bindus in 8th house from Lagna in that planet's ashtakavarga (before reductions) known
outcome: Ayus of planet = Shodhyapinda x bindus in 8th from Lagna / 27; sum of 7 (minus 100 if above 100) is ayuspinda; convert nakshatra years to solar years by x324/365
strength_note: Nakshatra year = 324 days

input: Shodhyapinda of planet (rasipinda + grahapinda) divided by 30 gives years (keep 12 if above 12 after removing 12-year cycles)
outcome: Planet's ayus = that figure, then modified: exalted double; debilitated or combust halve; intermediate position proportional between exaltation and debilitation (planet's distance from debilitation point /180 applied); retrograde Mars double
strength_note: Sum of 7 planets (plus Lagna ayus from Lagna ashtakavarga per Parasara) is full life span

input: Planet in moolatrikona, own house, friend's house, benefic varga or conjunct or aspected by benefics / in malefic or inimical varga
outcome: Its ayus figure is increased / reduced correspondingly
strength_note: qualitative

input: Bindus in the house occupied by each planet in its own ashtakavarga (Sun..Saturn), with same exaltation-proportion modifications
outcome: Sum of these planet-house contributions gives life period
strength_note: Method of sl.13

input: Pindayu-type method: Shodhyapinda x 7 / 27 for each planet
outcome: Quotient is that planet's years; if above 27 and below 54 subtract from 54; if 54-81 subtract 54; if 81-108 subtract from 108
strength_note: 27-year cycle reduction

input: Two or more planets in the same bhava / planet debilitated or combust / planet in inimical house / planet defeated in planetary war / Sun or Moon conjunct Rahu or Ketu within prescribed degrees
outcome: Planet's ayus reduced: conjunction by one half each; debilitation or combustion by one half; inimical house by one third; war defeat by one third; Sun/Moon with node by one third
strength_note: Only the single largest applicable reduction is applied

input: Malefic planet in 12th / 11th / 10th / 9th / 8th / 7th house from Lagna (visible half of zodiac)
outcome: Ayus reduction: 12th all removed; 11th one half; 10th one third; 9th one quarter; 8th one fifth; 7th one sixth
strength_note: Benefic planets in same houses get half of these reductions; planets in houses 1-6 and Lagna ayus get none

input: Samudayashtakavarga: after cycles of 12 removed, trikona and ekadhipatya reductions, multiplied by rasi and graha multipliers to get Shodhyapinda
outcome: Ayus in nakshatra years = Shodhyapinda x 7 / 27 (max 100), converted to solar years by x324/365; raise or lower by 27-year cycles according to Lagna aspected by malefics or benefics and short/middle/long life by other methods
strength_note: Example: 324 x7/27 = 84 nakshatra years = 74y6m23d solar

input: Samudaya ayus and individual bhinnayus of the 8 (7 planets and Lagna) known
outcome: Each dasa period = bhinnayus x samudaya ayus / sum of 8 bhinnayus
strength_note: Ashtakavarga dasa system

input: Moon strong but not in kendra; or a strong planet other than Moon in a kendra; or Moon conjunct a planet outside kendra; or 10th house has both benefics and malefics
outcome: Use Bhinnashtakavarga ayus (individual planet ayus) dasa periods
strength_note: Otherwise use samudaya ayus

input: Moon conjunct a planet in a kendra; or other planets weak and outside kendras; or strong Moon alone in a kendra
outcome: Use Samudayashtakavarga ayus dasa periods
strength_note: Maniththa: Moon with exactly one planet in kendra and rest outside kendras also samudaya

input: Ordering of ashtakavarga dasas among Lagna, Moon, Sun and the planets
outcome: Strongest of Lagna, Moon, Sun gives first dasa; then planets in kendras from it in order of strength; then those in panaphara houses; then those in apoklima houses
strength_note: Planet's dasa length = its ayus figure

input: Antardasa order inside ashtakavarga mahadasa
outcome: Sub-period lords: planet conjunct dasa lord 1 part? dasa lord itself 1 part, planet conjunct him 1/2, planets in 9th and 5th from dasa lord 1/3, planet in 7th 1/7, planets in 8th and 4th 1/4; if several in a bhava only strongest counts; fractions made to common denominator and dasa length shared pro rata
strength_note: Houses counted taking dasa lord's longitude as lagna

input: Dasa lord's own house in his ashtakavarga has bindus more than rekhas / rekhas more than bindus / equal
outcome: Dasa is auspicious / adverse / mixed
strength_note: Strength proportion by excess: excess 8 full, 7 three-quarters, 6 half, 5 quarter

input: At start of a dasa the dasa lord transits a bhava (in his own ashtakavarga) containing 8 bindus / 7 to 5 / 4 / fewer than 4
outcome: Effects full / auspicious / mixed / increasingly adverse

input: Dasa of a planet divided into 12 equal parts (years = months), starting with the house the planet occupies and moving through 12 houses from him; the house has fewer than 4 / 4 / 5 or more bindus in that planet's ashtakavarga
outcome: Corresponding twelfth of the dasa is inauspicious (loss of wealth, harvest, cattle) / mixed / prosperous (wealth)
strength_note: Alternate: count from Lagna so first twelfth gives results of the house the planet holds from Lagna; usable with Vimshottari and other dasas

input: Antardasa lord sits in a bhava with only 1, 2 or 3 bindus in the mahadasa lord's ashtakavarga

input: Antardasa lord owns two houses and both have 5+ bindus / both have few bindus / one high one low in mahadasa lord's ashtakavarga

input: Natal planet sits (in the bhava it occupies) with 1 to 3 bindus / exactly 4 bindus / 5 or more bindus in its own ashtakavarga

input: Antardasa lord owns two houses and both contain more than 5 bindus / less than 4 bindus in the mahadasa lord's ashtakavarga

input: Planet is in a bhava whose Samudayashtakavarga total exceeds 28 bindus

strength_note: Strong planet with many own bindus gives best results

input: Planet transits a bhava having more than 4 bindus / fewer than 4 bindus in its own ashtakavarga
outcome: Auspicious results / adverse results relating to that bhava

input: Planet is in a kakshya that holds a bindu / rekha in its ashtakavarga (Drekana-navamsa kind of place: chara = dhatu/minerals, sthira = moola/vegetable, ubhaya = jiva/animal)
outcome: Bindu: gain of the corresponding class of articles or happiness (stronger of planet and kakshya lord decides the type); rekha: loss of the same
strength_note: Quality (good / medium / coarse) from planet's exaltation, own house etc.

input: Jaimini aspects: movable sign / fixed sign / dual sign
outcome: Movable sign aspects all fixed signs except the adjacent one; fixed sign aspects all movable signs except the adjacent; dual sign aspects the other dual signs
strength_note: Planets in the aspected signs included

input: Jaimini rasi dasa: 9th house from Lagna in savya group (Aries Taurus Gemini Libra Scorpio Sagittarius) / apasavya group (Cancer Leo Virgo Capricorn Aquarius Pisces)
outcome: Dasa order runs forward from Lagna (1st, 2nd...) / backward (Lagna, 12th...); each rasi dasa length = number of signs from the rasi to its lord minus 1 counted in the same direction
strength_note: Modified by benefic or malefic disposition of lords

input: Yogini dasa
outcome: Cycle of 36 years from 8 yoginis giving 1,2,...8 years; initial dasa = (janma nakshatra number from Ashwini + 3) divided by 8, remainder gives starting yogini
strength_note: sl. from prologue summary

input: Planet transits a kakshya (one eighth of a sign) in its own ashtakavarga that holds a bindu / rekha
outcome: During the planet's passage through bindu kakshyas results are auspicious, through rekha kakshyas inauspicious; net result follows preponderance of bindus or rekhas in the bhava
strength_note: Each transit produces one type of result per kakshya, by the planet's house position from radical position of the kakshya lord

input: Dasa lord's/antara lord's transit is judged; at start of dasa and at time of transit the planet occupies a bhava with more bindus than rekhas in the dasa lord's ashtakavarga
outcome: Predicted event of the dasa will happen at that transit; if bindus very few, expected good does not materialise or is feeble
strength_note: Independent of the bhava transited

input: Transiting planets occupy bhavas with the maximum bindus in their own ashtakavargas during a good dasa / least bindus during the best dasa
outcome: Best results and timing of the dasa's good events / frustration or failure even in the best dasa
strength_note: Time events by transit through high-bindu bhavas

input: Bhava (transited by one or more planets) in Samudayashtakavarga has 28 or more bindus / fewer than 28 (average 28 per bhava, total 337)
outcome: Auspicious results, increasing with bindus / inauspicious
strength_note: Planet with fewer than 4 own bindus produces no good but no harm in that transit

input: Sun transits one kakshya (one eighth of the Sun's month in a sign, about 3-4 days) / Moon transits one kakshya (about 6 hrs 48 min)
outcome: Sun matures the good or bad results of that kakshya; Moon takes about 6h48m per kakshya; time of event narrowed by Sun and Moon being in bindu kakshyas, rising sign with maximum Samudaya bindus, kala-hora of strongest planet, and Lagna kakshya rising that has a bindu
strength_note: Muhurta use: pick day when sum of bindus of transiting planets in houses occupied is maximum

input: Karma/Bhoga/Nasa nature of sign or drekana

input: Computing Sun's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Lagna)

input: Computing Moon's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
strength_note: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give Jupiter donor houses 1,4,7,8,10,11,12 instead

input: Computing Mars's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
outcome: Mars receives a bindu from: Sun 3,5,6,10,11; Moon 3,6,11; Mars 1,2,4,7,8,10,11; Mercury 3,5,6,11; Jupiter 6,10,11,12; Venus 6,8,11,12; Saturn 1,4,7,8,9,10,11; Lagna 1,3,6,10,11 (total 39)

input: Computing Mercury's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
strength_note: Parasara

input: Computing Jupiter's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
strength_note: Parasara

input: Computing Venus's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
strength_note: Brihat Jataka gives Mars donor houses 3,5,6,9,11,12

input: Computing Saturn's ashtakavarga: houses counted from each donor
outcome: Saturn receives a bindu from: Sun 1,2,4,7,8,10,11; Moon 3,6,11; Mars 3,5,6,10,11,12; Mercury 6,8,9,10,11,12; Jupiter 5,6,11,12; Venus 6,11,12; Saturn 3,5,6,11; Lagna 1,3,4,6,10,11 (total 39)
strength_note: Parasara

input: Bindus and rekhas in a bhava of a planet's ashtakavarga cancel each other; transit of that planet
outcome: Only the net remaining points bear fruit; remaining good results increase when the house is upachaya (3,6,10,11), friendly, own or exaltation, and weaken in apachaya, inimical or debilitation houses; net rekha excess is worse in apachaya houses and a little better in upachaya
strength_note: Samudaya bhava with 28 or more bindus auspicious, fewer inauspicious

input: Total bindus in each of the seven planets' ashtakavargas
outcome: Sun 48, Moon 49, Mars 39, Mercury 54, Jupiter 56, Venus 52, Saturn 39; Samudaya total 337 (rekhas 48,47,57,42,40,44,57 totalling 335 in the other count)
strength_note: Lagna is a donor only, not a recipient

input: Computing Lagna's ashtakavarga (used only for ayurdaya): houses counted from each donor
strength_note: Not added into Samudaya (337 total, average 28 per bhava)

input: Computing Rahu's ashtakavarga (Yavanacharya only): houses counted from each donor
outcome: Rahu receives a bindu from: Sun 1,2,3,5,7,8,10; Moon 1,3,5,7,8,9,10; Mars 2,3,5,12; Mercury 2,4,7,8,12; Jupiter 1,3,4,6,8; Venus 6,7,11,12; Saturn 3,5,7,10,11,12; Lagna 3,4,5,9,12 (total 43)
strength_note: Not included in Samudaya; may be used for Rahu transit

input: Trikona shodhana: within each trine (Aries Leo Sagittarius; Taurus Virgo Capricorn; Gemini Libra Aquarius; Cancer Scorpio Pisces) all three signs' bindu counts
outcome: Subtract the smallest count from all three; if one sign has zero no reduction; if all three equal remove all
strength_note: Mantresvara: if two of three are zero also remove third (Parasara: no change); Prasnamarga similar

input: Ekadhipatya shodhana after trikona shodhana for a planet owning two signs (both signs have bindus)
outcome: Both signs unoccupied and unequal: subtract smaller from both; one occupied with fewer bindus: subtract its count from the unoccupied one only; occupied sign with more bindus than unoccupied: remove all from the unoccupied; both occupied: no change; both unoccupied and equal: remove all from both; equal and one occupied: remove from the unoccupied one; no reduction if either sign has zero; Cancer and Leo not reduced
strength_note: Parasara

input: Shodhya pinda: rasi multipliers applied to remaining bindus
outcome: Rasipinda = sum of bindus x sign multiplier (Aries 7, Taurus 10, Gemini 8, Cancer 4, Leo 10, Virgo 5, Libra 7, Scorpio 8, Sagittarius 9, Capricorn 5, Aquarius 11, Pisces 12); Grahapinda = sum of bindus in signs occupied by Sun, Moon, Mercury, Saturn x5, Mars x8, Jupiter x10, Venus x7; Shodhyapinda = Rasipinda + Grahapinda
strength_note: Sign multipliers read from OCR where clear: Taurus and Leo 10, Gemini and Scorpio 8, Libra and Aries 7, Virgo and Capricorn 5, Cancer 4, Sagittarius 9; Aquarius and Pisces by sign number (11, 12)

input: Bhava (sign house) total of bindus across the seven planets' ashtakavargas plus Lagna's is 8 / 5-7 / 1-3 / 4 / 0
outcome: 8: very strong, bestows all prosperity; 5,6,7: auspicious; 1-3: not auspicious; 4: mixed; 0: death, censure and fear
strength_note: Chap IV sl.26-27 (per bhava)

input: Planet in natal bhava that has exactly 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 bindus in its own ashtakavarga
outcome: 1: various diseases, sorrow, fear, wandering; 2: mental agony, censure, loss of food through king or robber; 3: troubles from roaming, lean body, afflicted mind; 4: mixed comforts and discomforts, income and expenditure
strength_note: Planet's own ashtakavarga

input: Planet in natal bhava that has 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 bindus in its own ashtakavarga
outcome: 5: fine apparel, children, virtuous contacts, learning, wealth; 6: fresh attractive appearance, excellent character, victory in war, wealth, fame, strength, conveyance; 7: honour, horses and conveyances, army, immense wealth; 8: regal splendour with sevenfold adjuncts (lord, minister, friends, treasure, domain, forts, army)
strength_note: Planet's own ashtakavarga

input: Planet transits a bhava having 5 or more bindus / 3 or fewer / 0 in its own ashtakavarga
outcome: Always auspicious / unable to give good results / definitely oppressive
strength_note: Per planet's own ashtakavarga

input: Planet passes through a bhava having 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 bindus in its own ashtakavarga
outcome: 1 misery; 2 loss of wealth; 3 anguish; 4 status quo; 5 great rejoicing; 6 inflow of wealth; 7 all sorts of happiness; 8 perfection of everything
strength_note: Count in the transited bhava

input: In a planet's ashtakavarga bindus exceed rekhas by 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 (reverse if rekhas exceed)
outcome: 2: inflow of wealth; 4: increase in confidence and new friends; 6: great valour, splendour, fame; 8: become king or equal to king
strength_note: Rekha excess gives reverse results

input: Planet in exaltation, own or friendly sign and strong in kendra/trikona has fewer than 4 bindus in own ashtakavarga
outcome: Produces evil results regardless of dignity
strength_note: Number of bindus overrides other strengths

input: Planet in 6th, 8th, 12th, debilitated or inimical sign (rasi or navamsa) has 5 or more bindus in own ashtakavarga
outcome: Produces good results
strength_note: Number of bindus overrides other strengths

input: Saturn transits a bhava with no bindu in the ashtakavarga of Sun / Moon / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus
outcome: Acute disease, fear from enemies and affliction to the karaka relation: Sun father, Moon mother, Mars siblings, Mercury relatives and maternal uncle, Jupiter children, Venus wife
strength_note: Saturn is karaka of self

input: Planet in its own ashtakavarga has bhavas with many bindus and bhavas with few bindus
outcome: Planet transiting the high-bindu bhavas gives good results of that bhava counted from the natal house of that planet (to native and to the planet's karaka relation); low-bindu bhavas give adverse results
strength_note: Example: Sun's ashtakavarga has 6 bindus in 7th from Sun: father benefits in 7th-house matters when Sun transits there; 2 bindus in 2nd: money loss, family trouble

input: Karaka planet sits in the house it signifies: Sun in 9th, Moon in 4th, Mars in 3rd, Jupiter in 5th, Venus in 7th, Saturn in 8th
outcome: Generally distresses the matters of that bhava
strength_note: Some authors

input: Planet occupies 6th, 8th or 12th house
outcome: Malefic there gives good results; benefic there gives bad results; malefic in friend's sign or exaltation gives good results; benefic in inimical sign, debilitation or combust turns hostile
strength_note: Chap IV sl.10-11

input: Sum of bindus in a planet's ashtakavarga for Aries+Leo+Sagittarius (east) / Taurus+Virgo+Capricorn (south) / Gemini+Libra+Aquarius (west) / Cancer+Scorpio+Pisces (north)
outcome: The direction with the highest total is very auspicious, the lowest inauspicious
strength_note: Alternative: direction of the bhava with most bindus per fixed chart (Sthirachakra); moveable chart: Lagna east, 7th west, 10th south, 4th north

input: Examine relatives: take the sign occupied by Sun / Moon / Mars / Mercury / Jupiter / Venus as Lagna
outcome: Judge father / mother / siblings / maternal uncle and relatives / children / wife from the 12 houses counted from that karaka (2nd prosperity, 3rd siblings, 4th happiness and mother, 5th intelligence, 6th sickness, 7th passion, 8th death and longevity, 9th merit and grandfather, 10th avocation, 11th income, 12th expenditure)
strength_note: Bhava effect is assured if bhava, its lord and karaka are strong

input: Jupiter, Venus and Mercury occupy Lagna, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th singly or jointly (Saraswati yoga)

input: Vimshottari mahadasha divided into 8 equal parts mapped in order to the prastharaka kakshyas of the 10th lord in the sign he occupies (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Lagna); part's kakshya has a bindu

input: Natal 3rd, 5th and 10th lords and Mercury, Jupiter bonded by position, aspect or conjunction

input: Mars and Mercury in mutual aspect; Mercury in Aries or Scorpio; Mars in Mercury's sign; link in navamsha

input: Women's careers: Amatyakaraka is in the sign, in 10th house or aspects 10th house when career was made (5 case studies); favourable dasha but no strong rajayoga

input: 7th lord associated with Venus

input: Moon's rasi longitude added to 8th lord's; or Jupiter transits 2nd from navamsha position of Lagna lord; or Jupiter and Moon together

input: Transit Saturn and Jupiter aspect (i) Lagna and 7th house, (ii) Lagna lord and 7th lord, (iii) Lagna lord and 7th house, or (iv) Lagna and 7th lord

input: Varshaphal (annual chart) rule 1: Venus in 7th house of progressed horoscope, or 7th lord, aspected by Jupiter

input: Varshaphal rule 2: Lagna lord (or its sign) of birth chart is well placed in 7th house of annual chart

input: Varshaphal rule 3 and 5: sign occupied by natal Venus becomes 7th house of annual chart and Venus becomes lord of the year (Varsha-raat)

input: Varshaphal rule 4: year lord is in the 7th house occupied by natal Venus, or Venus holding one of the Panchadhikari offices is with or aspected by Mars

input: Varshaphal rule 6: lord of 7th house in ithasal (applying aspect) with Vivah Saham (Venus - Saturn + Lagna), or lords of Lagna and Vivah Saham in ithasal
